board: Joy-IT KY-004 button module (black 3-pin SensorKit board with black tactile button; header S, + (middle), -)
reason: Modelled as an active-low digital sensor (tactile button from S to GND with on-board 10k pull-up to +, S LOW while pressed); debounced driver with active_low option for pull-down clones; check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the second run after adding wait steps between set steps.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://arduinomodules.info/ky-004-key-switch-module/ (S, middle +, -; Joy-IT is the pull-up variant), confirmed by Joy-IT board photo https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/files/files/sensors/KY-004/KY-004.png
